correctness.rationale: The proof reduces every Euclidean pullback, not merely a chosen family, by averaging its quadratic form over the four sign-reflection isometries in orthogonal coordinates. This preserves both comparison constants and cancels the mixed term. Exact sector formulas then give \(D(t)=4/t\) for \(0<t\le3\) and \(D(t)=(t+1)^2/(4t)\) for \(t\ge3\), uniquely minimized at \(t=3\) with value \(4/3\). Rescaling gives \(|(x,y)|_*^2=x^2-xy+y^2\), and explicit equality vectors realize both bounds. Boundary compatibility and positive-definiteness are checked explicitly.
